description: A record representing a world event, announcement, or narrative beat published by a realm's game master.

title.description: The title of the world event.

text.description: The main description of the event.

image.description: An optional image associated with the event.

locationRef.description: An optional strong reference to a location where this event is taking place or is relevant.

expiresAt.description: An optional timestamp for when the event is no longer considered active.
